intro.text: A guide who leads boats through the Reshi Sea.

items.text: Gu guided Vstim's convoy to a Reshi island, riding in Rysn's boat. He said the islands had become harder to find as they moved in unexpected ways, and was amused when Rysn realized the island was a huge greatshell and that many of its people went naked. He explained that boats can't dock on such a creature, so crews sleep on open water and find the island in the morning.

appearance.text: Gu has leathery skin, long limbs and dark hair, and nearly always lounges.

personality.text: Easygoing and unconcerned with schedules, he speaks Thaylen well and some Reshi, steers skillfully around underwater trees, and believes the great island-creatures are thinking beings.
